notes: Builds the per-category summary the macro's tail produces. Uses PROC SQL ... INTO :__obs_e / :__obs_w / :__obs_n / :__obs_i — the exact form interact_logchk uses (lines 232-239) — to count flagged rows by category, then %PUT each count and the dm-post message body the macro would popup in the SAS GUI. PROC FREQ provides the cross-check. From the inline 11-row sample: ERROR=3, WARNING=2, NOTE=5, INFO=1, total=11.
